psychological_meaning: Gray is often associated with neutrality, balance, and sophistication. It can convey a sense of calmness and composure, while also suggesting formality and professionalism. Depending on the shade, gray can evoke feelings of practicality and reliability, but also potentially, detachment or a lack of emotion. Gray is a stable and versatile color, often used as a backdrop to allow other colors to stand out.
